title: For a century, journalists have had voluntary ethics code. Editors are giving it AI-era reboot
description: The Society of Professional Journalists is updating its ethics code after twelve years. This revision addresses the rapid emergence of artificial intelligence in newsrooms. It also aims to include independent "creator journalists" in ethical guidelines. The code seeks to rebuild public trust in journalism and its practitioners.

description: Literacy ambassador Aditi Paudel: Aditi Paudel, a 17-year-old student, has become Japans first literacy ambassador. She champions reading and education, drawing on her unique background and personal experiences. Paudel aims to empower young people and promote literacy globally. Her work also addresses declining reading habits and the potential impact of artificial intelligence. She believes literacy can unlock opportunities, encourage deeper thinking and broaden perspectives.
